decisions.reason: As a sensor module very close to the firm's existing hardware, firmware and API base, its move from a mere mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 indicates learning and enough traction to justify continued commercialization.

This industrial AC input module builds directly on the firm's core automation and measurement know-how, and its sustained dedicated presentation on the website suggests a strategically relevant product the firm can further refine with its in-house R&D.

Although its web presence is modest, a solid state relay module fits tightly with the firm's modular control architecture, so the firm is likely to keep it as a complementary building block rather than drop a knowledge-related product with portfolio value.

Because this 2024 RGB LED control module relies on the same modular electronics and software ecosystem as the established offer, management would likely keep it on the market to accumulate feedback and exploit existing absorptive capacity before judging it harshly.

The remote access service for wallboxes matches the firm's stated expansion into charging and energy management and draws on its software and connected-device capabilities, making it a strategically important product to retain and develop.
